 def run(workspace, content_bytes, fault=None):

+

+            raise OSError('controlled handoff failure')
+        
+        # Handoff to consumer
+        workspace.permissions(file_id, allowed=('consumer',))
+        
+        # Clean up the file
+        workspace.remove(file_id)
+        
+        return ('ok', content)

+        # Handle any faults that occurred
